correctness.rationale: The two actual source programs were run. The main checker exhaustively enumerates 234 six-point nontrivial blocking sets, the projective stabilizer of order 24, 567 quartic coefficient classes with exactly those six rational points, 222 geometrically smooth curves after exhaustive affine Gröbner ideal-unit tests, and ten projective orbits of sizes 6 and 24 nine times. Exact point counts for every representative over F3,F9,F27 determine their genus-three Weil polynomials. A second implementation over different irreducible polynomials reproduces all ten sets of point counts and coefficient vectors. Homogeneity plus Euler in characteristic three validates the Jacobian criterion, and degree-four smoothness implies genus three.

value.rationale: The minimum six-point nontrivial blocking configuration in PG(2,3) is an extremal finite-geometric object, and its intersection with geometrically smooth quartics gives a natural genus-three moduli stratum. The exact ten distinct Frobenius polynomials prove the stratum intersects ten separate Jacobian isogeny classes, a nontrivial arithmetic strengthening not implied by the ten projective orbits or by common N1=6. This is a complete finite arithmetic classification of a motivated locus, not an arbitrary coefficient slice.
